Panel.hiddenUntilFound.semantic: uses hidden='until-found' so find-in-page can reveal and expand the panel; overrides keepMounted; panel stays mounted and indexable

renderProp: Per-part `render` (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement) via useRender; mergeProps for combining.
controlled: Uncontrolled `defaultOpen`; controlled `open` + `onOpenChange(open, eventDetails)` (reason 'trigger-press' or 'none'). No handle/detached-trigger mechanism, no actionsRef.
formIntegration: None — no hidden inputs, name/value or validation. Trigger renders a native <button>.
keyboard: Trigger is a native <button>: Enter/Space toggle the panel. No arrow-key navigation, no roving focus, no focus trapping; the panel is not focus-managed. `disabled` suppresses interaction.
notableDifferences: Props are open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange and disabled — not isExpanded/isDisabled.

Panel animation is attribute + variable driven: style height: var(--collapsible-panel-height) with transitions on [data-starting-style]/[data-ending-style], instead of React Aria's render-prop style functions.
hiddenUntilFound gives real find-in-page support via the HTML hidden='until-found' attribute (React Aria has no equivalent).
Panel must not be sized with height:100% when animating; the CSS var is authoritative.
